answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the echo of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cipher of the next round. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
